title: UIP-1 Capability Descriptor
description: Machine-readable declaration of what an agent can do, at what price, under what SLA. Carried as the body of an announce envelope with content_type application/uip-descriptor+json. Its authenticity comes from the enclosing envelope signature; it carries no signature of its own.

agent.description: DID of the described agent. MUST equal the from field of the enclosing envelope.

expires.description: Epoch ms after which the descriptor must not be considered in force.

input_schema.description: JSON Schema draft 2020-12 for the request. A foreign agent MUST be able to validate against it with no prior knowledge.

output_schema.description: JSON Schema draft 2020-12 for the response.

price.description: A price offer, not a contract. The contract is formed by the receipt. Absence means free.

x.description: Extensions, keyed by reverse namespace. Used by bridges to preserve identifiers that do not survive translation, so a round trip through MCP or A2A returns the original document unchanged. Receivers MUST ignore keys they do not recognize.

availability.description: Decimal fraction as a string, e.g. "0.9999".

allOf.description: The HTTPS binding is mandatory for every conforming implementation and requires TLS.

decimalAmount.description: Exact decimal string. Never a JSON number: binary floating point for money is a conformance defect.
